violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: oat milk in the walk-in refrigerator was 46ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC stated the oat milk was received earlier this morning and was cooling. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed newspaper being used to line the shelves in the walk-in refrigerator. Observed a bare wood shelf being used in the small dry storage area to store clean equipment on.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Do not use newspaper to line shelves. Bare wood shelves are not easily cleanable it will absorb moisture and become stained. Paint the shelf to make it easily cleanable. The PIC discarded the newspaper during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient air temperature of the Leader three door prep refrigerator was 50°F, which is not cold enough to keep foods cold. Also, the ambient temperature of the walk-in refrigerator was 44º.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the units so they are able to maintain foods at or below 41F. The only foods in the unit that must be kept cold or the Napa cabbage, which was 42°F. Do not use this unit for foods that must be kept cold. Have the units serviced as soon as possible and notify your EHS when it is working properly again. A follow up is required for these issues. VEGAN LOVERS (Inspection Date: 04/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Observed food debris and other visible soiled areas on the shelving in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Clean all surfaces of the walk-in refrigerator shelving. This is necessary to prevent food from becoming contaminated by debris falling into it. Correct as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that toilet room doors are being kept open. The self closer on the men’s restroom door does not work, so the restroom door stays open when it is unoccupied.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. Repair the men’s restroom door self closer as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed a significant amount of grease built-up on the vertical gas pipe next to the left side of the hood system. Also observed grease on the wall next to the pipe and the ceiling panels above and around it. Several ceiling panels were damaged, severely stained, or visibly soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the excess grease off the vertical gas pipe and the wall next to it. Replace the ceiling panels that are damaged, visibly stained, and visibly soiled. Correct as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed galvanized steel piping extending vertically down from the ceiling, serving as diffusers for the HVAC system. These are not the appropriate equipment for this purpose. The establishment has a screen door in addition to the rear door. The screen door is severely damaged and is not capable of keeping flying insects from entering.
violations.corrective_action: Replace all the vertical piping with proper HVAC ceiling diffusers. Repair the screen door if you want to keep the back door open, or keep the back door closed at all times. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.
